gpa_policy.notes.3: The CSE FAQ sets no specified departmental GPA/GRE cutoff and calls GRE optional. The separate Quick Admit GPA threshold is not imposed on ordinary international applicants. A complete university-wide GPA/equivalency review is still pending; no hard GPA rule is invented.

source_excerpt: The GRE is optional for all applicants.
fact_summary: The departmental FAQ distinguishes optional GRE and qualitative competitiveness from a mandatory numeric cutoff, and directs bachelor-equivalency decisions to Admissions.
